name: Intatto
description: Intatto is a lending market on X Layer where holders of tokenized US stocks (xStocks such as NVDAx) borrow USDG. Borrowing limits follow the real stock market session, the price is a keeper relay bounded onchain, liquidation is bounded while the market is closed and losses run through an explicit reserve-then-lender waterfall. This agent answers, from onchain reads at one block, how much a wallet can borrow right now and how close its loan is to liquidation.
serviceDescription:
Returns the credit and health of one wallet's Intatto loan on X Layer (USDG borrowed against tokenized stocks): market session and its new-borrow limit, USDG borrowable now or the exact contract error that refuses a borrow, the keeper's price with its fetch time, the price guards, collateral, debt, LTV, health factor, liquidation price and the percent fall that would make the loan liquidatable. Read-only, all values onchain at one block.
wallet (string, required): the borrower's 0x address, lowercase or EIP-55, e.g. 0x7F23b131F7312bd0f63EF79974E215Dc3E12a415; market (string, required): NVDAx or SPYx, e.g. NVDAx; network (string, optional, default mainnet): mainnet (X Layer, chain 196) or sandbox (a fork session), e.g. mainnet; session (string, optional): fork session id, only with network=sandbox, e.g. zfzgj3Z8H3OReI3wCs-Sxw; chain (integer, optional): 196 for mainnet or 1960196 for sandbox, e.g. 196
GET
curl -s 'https://intatto.larinova.com/api/credit?wallet=0x7F23b131F7312bd0f63EF79974E215Dc3E12a415&market=NVDAx'
purpose: Lets an agent decide whether a wallet can borrow more, should repay, or is close to liquidation, before it acts for a user.

x402_when_paid.note: Paid mode is off. It only builds the challenge; verification and settlement are not wired until a real paid settlement is proven.

required.name: wallet
required.description: The borrower's address, all lowercase or EIP-55 checksummed.

required.name: market
required.description: The tokenized stock used as collateral.

optional.name: network
optional.description: mainnet reads X Layer (chain 196). sandbox reads a fork session from the Intatto sandbox.

optional.name: session
optional.description: Sandbox session id. Only with network=sandbox.

fields.block: integer, the block every value was read at
fields.session.maxNewBorrowLtvBps: integer, the highest LTV a new borrow may reach in this session
fields.session.periodChangedAt: ISO 8601 | null, when the issuer's current trading period began
fields.session.postedAt: ISO 8601 | null, the keeper's last session post
fields.price.usdPerToken: decimal string | null, USD per whole token
fields.price.fetchedAt: ISO 8601 | null, the keeper's fetch time (keeper liveness, not market freshness)
fields.price.sourceTimestamp: always null: the issuer's quote carries no source timestamp
fields.guards.fresh: boolean, the last price post is within its liveness limit
fields.guards.inBand: boolean, the price is inside the band around the pool's 30-minute TWAP
fields.guards.pegOk: boolean, USDG/USD is fresh and within 1% of $1
fields.guards.corporateActionPaused: boolean, a split or dividend is activating
fields.guards.issuerPaused: boolean, the token issuer paused the stock
fields.position.collateralTokens: decimal string, underlying tokens held as collateral
fields.position.collateralWrapperShares: decimal string, ERC-4626 wrapper shares the market holds
fields.position.valueUsdg: decimal string, collateral value in USDG
fields.position.debtUsdg: decimal string, debt including accrued interest
fields.position.ltvBps: integer | null (null: debt with no collateral value)
fields.position.healthFactor: decimal string | null (null: no debt); below 1 is liquidatable
fields.capacity.borrowableNowUsdg: decimal string, USDG one borrow can take right now
fields.capacity.limitBps: integer, the session's new-borrow LTV limit
fields.capacity.reason: optional: UnknownSession | SessionLimit | StalePrice | PriceOutOfBand | CorporateActionPending | TickerCapReached | UsdgOffPeg | IssuerPaused | InsufficientLiquidity, the contract error a borrow would revert with now
fields.liquidation.thresholdBps: integer, LTV above which the position is liquidatable (never depends on the session)
fields.liquidation.liquidationPriceUsd: decimal string | null, token price at the threshold (null: no debt)
fields.liquidation.gapToLiquidationBps: integer | null, the fall in the token price, in bps of today's price, that makes the position liquidatable
